name: ES Notable — Open Playbook Builder
description: When ES exports a notable to SOAR, run the Open Playbook Builder utility playbook so analysts get a case note with the sidecar link.
comments: 3. Name: ES Notable — Open Playbook Builder
5. Condition: label contains es_notable_response OR label contains notable (match your ES export label)
6. Action: Run playbook → Open Playbook Builder
Optional REST (SOAR 6.x+): POST /rest/response_plan with your session — field names vary by version.
Verify with: Administration → Response Plans after import.

actions.notes: Adds case note with get sidecar url link (container_id + ES artifact hints)

es_export_prerequisite.summary: ES must export notables to SOAR with a matching container label
steps: Splunk ES → Configure → Incident Review → Splunk SOAR Integration
Enable export; set playbook/response label to es_notable_response (or update condition above)
Confirm new cases appear in SOAR with CEF artifacts including event_id
